rationale: P identifies the vehicle braking behaviour that must be characterised to evaluate prevention of unintended braking, as required by SG-3 and illustrated by hazard H-3. Its operational scope matches the hazard. Braking behaviour is itself the subject of evaluation, rather than merely a mechanism affecting it. P does not extend to sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, warnings, or mechanism timing constraints.
determining_elements: “The vehicle's braking behavior” identifies the behaviour directly evaluated by T.
“Whether braking occurs as intended or unintentionally” captures the property relevant to SG-3.
The declared scope matches H-3: straight-ahead driving on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h, with no visible obstacles or vehicles ahead, in good weather.
